label: Game settlement types
summary: Explicit game, rules, participant, asset, amount, nonce and deadline bindings for a project-specific settlement design.
maturityMeaning: Hash-bound reference scaffold only; project-specific implementation and evidence are required before prototype readiness.
dependencyRequirements: Project-specific outcome proof or signer architecture
requiredFacts: Bind immutable game rules, outcome authority, participants, stake source and payout destination
Define disconnect, timeout, draw, dispute, replay and duplicate-settlement behavior
Keep game simulation state outside consensus unless its exact proof is verified
hardConflictPredicates: The same game outcome can settle more than once
An outcome proof does not bind the exact rules, participants, asset and amount
A privileged actor can redirect a settled payout outside the disclosed game rule
